name: Brain and Cognitive Sciences
notes: Six courses. A maximum of two courses may overlap between a student's major and minor.
Independent study courses (39x) cannot be included.
The department also offers a Visual Science minor, not yet encoded.

requirementGroups.label: Core courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: BCSC 110: Neural Foundations of Behavior; BCSC 111: Foundations of Cognitive Science

requirementGroups.label: Breadth courses (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two of the following: BCSC 151: Perception and Action; BCSC 152: Language and Psycholinguistics; BCSC 153: Cognition

requirementGroups.label: Elective at 200 or higher
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two electives, at least one must be numbered 200 or higher. Independent study courses (39x) CANNOT be included.
